title: Across Chest Shoulder Stretch
description: Static stretch that opens the shoulder and releases tension across the chest and upper back.

exercises.name: Across Chest Shoulder Stretch
exercises.description: Bring one arm across your chest and gently press it closer with the opposite hand until you feel a stretch in the shoulder.
instructions: Stand tall and relax your shoulders.
Bring one arm straight across your chest.
Use your other arm to gently pull it closer.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch sides.

exercises.name: Alternate Biceps Curl Standing Dumbbells
exercises.description: Curl one dumbbell at a time while standing, alternating arms.
instructions: Stand tall holding a dumbbell in each hand, arms at your sides.
Curl one dumbbell up toward your shoulder, keeping your elbow still.
Lower with control, then repeat with the other arm.
Continue alternating for the full set.
